Question
========

Let polynomial function $f$ have a leading coefficient `r a`, degree `r n`, and constant `r d`.

$$f(x)~=~`r a`x^{`r n`}+\cdots+`r d`$$

However, the other coefficients are unknown. By picking values for those other coefficients, what is the most number of [extrema](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maximum_and_minimum) possible?

Solution
========

To find the maximum number of extrema possible, take the degree of the polynomial and subtract 1. In this case, $`r n`-1=`r n-1`$.

So a polynomial of degree `r n` will have at most `r n-1` extrema.
